Based on the search results, here are the key ASUS 4K monitors announced in 2026:

## Gaming Monitors

The ROG Swift OLED PG32UCDM Gen 3 is a 32-inch 4K QD-OLED monitor with 240Hz refresh rate, 0.03ms response time, and BlackShield film.

The ROG Strix XG27UCMG is the world's first 4K triple-mode gaming monitor.

The ROG Swift OLED PG27UCWM is a 26.5-inch Tandem RGB Stripe OLED monitor that offers 4K@240Hz or ultrafast FHD@480Hz with a 0.03ms response time.

## Professional/Creative Monitors

The PA279CDV features a 26.5-inch 4K UHD QD-OLED panel with 99% DCI-P3 color gamut, Delta E<2 color accuracy, 1000-nits peak brightness, and a 120Hz refresh rate.

The ProArt Display 4K QD-OLED lineup includes the 31.5-inch PA32USD that delivers up to 240Hz refresh rate and 1000-nits peak brightness.

The 31.5-inch ProArt Display OLED PA32UCDMR-K and 26.5-inch PA27UCDMR are 4K UHD QD-OLED monitors that offer Delta E<1 accuracy, 1000-nits peak brightness, and 240Hz refresh rate.
